Class BuildingCard

java.lang.Object
mesos.cards.Card
mesos.cards.BuildingCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BuildingCard extends Card
A building card that a player can purchase and add to their tribe. Delegates all effect logic to a BuildingEffect strategy object.

  • Constructor Details

    • BuildingCard

      public BuildingCard(String name, Era era, int foodCost, int printedPrestigePoints, BuildingEffect effect)
      Creates a building card.
      Parameters:
      name - display name
      era - the era this card belongs to
      foodCost - base food cost before discounts
      printedPrestigePoints - prestige points printed on the card (before end-game bonus)
      effect - building effect strategy; null is treated as no effect
